text: Jennifer Corvino, daughter of a famous American actor, [arrives at a Swiss girls' academy|who_suffers|newcomers and travellers] where [someone has been killing young girls|threat|people who kill]. Sleepwalking into the woods, she is led by a chimpanzee to the entomologist John McGregor, who finds that insects are drawn to her as if by telepathy. When classmates taunt her, she [summons a swarm of flies over the whole school|images|vermin and creeping things], and a fly in a glass case guides her toward the killer and a house where [every mirror is covered|images|mirrors and glass].
